messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment r-2026-04-05-171881 to eu1 started canary at 10%
deploy-bot: Canary finished: 10/10 smoke checks passed (http, kvcache, kvprobe) :white_check_mark:
maria: noting a p95 bump on the eu1 kv-synth after the rollout, started ~30s post-canary. p95 -> 1.2s (baseline ~0.45s) and a few 503s showing up in the probe.
nate: do we have correlation with model variant vs runtime changes? this rollout had a tiny runtime kernel bump + kv cache TTL tweak.
sophie: logs show cache miss rate jumped for a subset of machines (hostgroup eu1-a). maybe warmup didn't fully populate prefix cache after instance rotation.
maria: here's the quick probe curl I'm running against the synthetic endpoint:```
curl -sS -X POST https://eu1-synth.redwood.internal/probe 
  -H 'X-Probe: kv' 
  -d '{"prefix":"/rtr/123","q":"embed"}' | jq '.latency_ms, .status'
```
ops-bot: alert: eu1.kvprobe.503 spike 6 events in 1m -> escalated to #eng-releases
tony: IMO we should avoid a full rollback. options: 1) pause expansion and pin eu1 to previous config (r-2026-03-28) 2) increase prefix warmup concurrency and continue rollout 3) rollback.
maria: agree to pause expansion. the failures look limited to a hostgroup and are consistent with cold-kv misses. i can kick a targeted warmup on those hosts and re-run the synth coverage.
nate: +1 for pause & pin. pinning ensures customers on eu1 don't get degraded latency while we verify. can we pin traffic routing at the LB level?
sophie: yes — can do a route pin to variant v20260328 for eu1 in routing service for the next 2h. i'll also start a warmup job: `scripts/warmup_kv --hosts eu1-a --concurrency 8`
maria: i'll run the synth extended run (1000 reqs over 2m) and post metrics. if p95 drops back near baseline and 503s stop, we unpin and resume ramp.
tony: who wants to own the post-pin verification? assign to maria, nate to validate telemetry and ops to confirm warmup. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: route-update: pinned eu1 -> v20260328 by sophie (reason: temporary latency regression)
deploy-bot: Rollout paused for eu1. Canary artifacts pinned to v20260328. Notifying release owners and scheduler.
maria: initial extended synth run shows p95 down to 0.48s, 503s -> 0. repo of traces shows miss ratio dropping. I'll leave extended run for +10m then report back.
nate: good catch. let's keep the change window open but do not advance to 50% until we confirm sustained stability.
sophie: will follow up with a short postmortem note in the release thread if we unpin, and include the warmup tweak as a mitigation.
tony: thanks team. decision: pause expansion, pin eu1 to previous variant, run warmup, validate via extended synth. rollback avoided for now.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Hold set on rollout eu1. Revert action remains available via manual rollback command.
